axes.name: Legal-effect class
axes.values: The ten ratified constitutional taxonomy classes, class-01 through class-10
axes.note: An author-chosen planning grammar, not derived and not exhaustive; preserved as its own axis and never reused as the domain axis.

axes.name: Social domain
axes.values: The twelve-cluster minimum inventory, FS-DOM-01 through FS-DOM-12
axes.note: Answers which part of life is involved and where its decisions belong; orthogonal to the legal-effect class.

axes.name: Layer (scope disposition)
axes.values: The five ratified routing dispositions, stored under the scope_disposition key
axes.note: One enum, one key. These five values are the reader-facing five-layer society map, author-ratified 2026-08-09. A leaf record carries exactly one; a domain record spans all five as its buckets.

axes.name: Claim posture
axes.values: Derived, Checked, Evidenced, Specified, Reasoned, Unestablished
axes.note: One posture per claim record; a record that would carry two is two records.

axes.name: Assurance route
axes.values: The seven ratified routes, FS-RTE-01 through FS-RTE-07
axes.note: A route establishes what it executes, over what it was given, and nothing further; one green route never stands in for another.

axes.name: Assurance overlay
axes.note: A liveness claim is never established today; a feasibility claim may not appear in Book 1 at all.

axes.name: Defect disposition
axes.values: The closed seven-value enum; the last three are explicit non-resolution boundaries
axes.note: Answers what the design did about a known failure; orthogonal to posture, route, overlay, class, and domain.

axes.name: Response stage
axes.note: Route-relative, not a universal total order; a stage supplies no assurance by itself.

scope_disposition_meanings.constitutional-invariant: The condition is guaranteed or refused by the constitution itself; no tier, majority, emergency, or remedy may lower it.
scope_disposition_meanings.democratic-ordinary-law-choice: A decision left to ordinary majorities inside the ratified corridor; the constitution bounds it without choosing it.
scope_disposition_meanings.protected-private-civic-freedom: A protected private or civic choice; an explicit non-prescription or non-interference disposition counts as coverage and authorises no rule, record, operator, or success certification.
scope_disposition_meanings.book-2-operation: Owned by Book 2: staffing, costs, capacity, resources, technology, workflows, transition, deployment, and operation under ordinary and declared shock conditions.
scope_disposition_meanings.external-assumption: A premise outside both books: named, owned, falsifiable, and never laundered into an established claim.

routing_marker_meanings.not-constitutionally-prescribed: The bucket is deliberately empty of constitutional content; the absence is the disposition, checked for rights harm, concentrated power, public duty, and commons effects.
routing_marker_meanings.democratic-ordinary-law-choice: The bucket's content is chosen by ordinary law inside the corridor.
routing_marker_meanings.book-2-operation: The bucket's content is routed to Book 2 as operation.
routing_marker_meanings.external-assumption: The bucket's content rests on a named external premise.

posture_meanings.Derived: An executable engine result over the exact current source, or over a named bounded mutation declared in a fixture or reviewed audit.
posture_meanings.Checked: A mechanical check establishing a property of the artifacts, never of the world and never a semantic impossibility.
posture_meanings.Evidenced: A claim about the world with population, period, place, and method.
posture_meanings.Specified: A complete contract, stated but not formalised; carries an explicit unimplemented marker.
posture_meanings.Reasoned: Argument against a named adversarial corpus; permanently weaker than Derived and never citable as it.
posture_meanings.Unestablished: Not established; carries exactly one named disposition.

unestablished_disposition_meanings.routed-book-2: Routed to Book 2; routing is a disposition, not assurance.
unestablished_disposition_meanings.external-assumption: Rests on a named external premise with owner and falsifier.
unestablished_disposition_meanings.route-unbuilt: Its only route is neither built nor available; carries severity, consequence, owner, closure condition, and a public-claim restriction.
unestablished_disposition_meanings.author-ruling-pending: Waits for a named author ruling; briefs may proceed, dependent work may not.
unestablished_disposition_meanings.refused: Deliberately refused by a standing ruling.
unestablished_disposition_meanings.not-establishable: No route could establish it as stated; the claim must narrow or stay unmade.

evidence_kind_meanings.executable: The pin suites and the record, temporal, amendment, placement, and counterfactual runs; the only kind that warrants Derived.
evidence_kind_meanings.pattern-guard: A guard that reads spelling or structure; a pattern guard is not a proof.
evidence_kind_meanings.freshness: A generator --check mode or staleness gate; currency, not truth.
evidence_kind_meanings.inventory: A reviewed operation set, record class, or scenario narrative; a reviewed threat model, explicitly not executable proof.

overlay_meanings.safety: May be Derived with a supplied-records scope bound and an enumerated non-extension clause.
overlay_meanings.liveness: Arrival, advance, action, release, delivery, repair; never Derived, Checked, or Reasoned; Unestablished until operational assurance exists.
overlay_meanings.feasibility: Needs models or simulations plus operational assurance; may not be written in Book 1 at all.
overlay_meanings.none: The claim asserts routing, structure, or method rather than a safety, liveness, or feasibility property.

route_status_meanings.built: Its check exists and runs in verify.sh.
route_status_meanings.available: Its evidence contract, admissibility criteria, named reviewer, and in-repo gate exist so outside evidence can be admitted.
route_status_meanings.unbuilt: Neither built nor available; naming a route does not build it.

defect_disposition_meanings.eliminated-structurally: The failure-producing route no longer exists in the declared model; the repaired source must refuse the former result for the intended reason.
defect_disposition_meanings.prevented: The initiating failure cannot arise within the named scope.
defect_disposition_meanings.protected-consequence-contained: The initiating failure may arise, but the named protected consequence cannot cross the stated boundary.
defect_disposition_meanings.remedied: After harm occurs, an evidenced route restores the protected condition; never proves prevention.
defect_disposition_meanings.externally-bounded-assumption: Closure depends on a premise outside the model; explicitly bounded is still not internally resolved.
defect_disposition_meanings.irreducible-limitation: The chosen model cannot close the failure without contradicting a settled boundary; honest limitation is not resolution.

response_stage_meanings.detected: The failure has a visible, attributable witness; nothing is yet specified, implemented, prevented, repaired, recovered, or resolved.
response_stage_meanings.interface-specified: Book 1 assigns a duty, evidence, continuity, challenge, or remedy interface, but no implemented route establishes its effect.
response_stage_meanings.implemented-in-assigned-route: The response exists in its assigned route; the stage supplies no assurance.
response_stage_meanings.operationally-assured-in-envelope: A staffed, costed, accountable route is exercised end to end in the named test setting; supports only the reproducible operational-design claim for that envelope.

resolution_status_meanings.resolved-for-claim: Generated only: the affected claim's ceiling, disposition, stage, route, and evidence jointly permit resolution for that claim alone.
resolution_status_meanings.unresolved-for-claim: Generated only: the default; detected, specified, assigned, implemented, disclosed, and understood are not synonyms for resolved.

proposal_disposition_meanings.added: The proposal entered the canonical source as records.
proposal_disposition_meanings.classified-out: Classified with reasons under the ratified dispositions or as duplicate or immaterial, carrying the matching Unestablished disposition.
proposal_disposition_meanings.retained-limit: Retained as an unresolved severity-rated limit with owner and closure condition.

compatibility_table.resolution_requirement: An executable reintroduction mutation on the formal route, or a preregistered reintroduction, ablation, hostile, or negative control on any other route; the repaired source or system must refuse the former result for the intended reason. Resolves only the named failure in its exact model.
Route-appropriate hostile and negative controls test the initiation boundary. Resolves only the initiating-failure claim.
Bypass, composition, and negative-control cases test the exact stated boundary. Resolves only the named consequence and boundary.

Requires an Evidenced liveness claim through operational assurance, recording actor, trigger, interim continuity, restoration, challenge, recurrence control, and evidence. Resolves only the recovery claim and never proves prevention.
Name the source or authenticator, falsifier, failure consequence, owner, and public-claim restriction. Explicitly bounded is still not internally resolved.
Supply the argument, alternatives considered, residual risk, and exact claim narrowing. Honest limitation is not resolution.
Carry severity, consequence, owner, closure condition, affected claims, and blocking gate. A critical unresolved defect blocks its affected claim.

domains.title: Personhood and life course
domains.applicability: every person within jurisdiction or effective control, from birth through death
domains.status: seeded-stage-1; routing complete at domain grain
domains.severity: critical if left open — every other domain hangs from standing
domains.consequence: an unrouted personhood question would let a record gate a person
domains.closure_condition: contract cards complete for standing, adulthood, and life-course rule families

constitutional_invariants.answer: Universal standing: every person counts before any other rule applies; personhood roots the floor, survives witnessed record replacement, and no tier, emergency, or remedy may remove it. A born child is an independent rights-holder; general adulthood arises automatically at one common-tier statutory age; plenary guardianship and status-based incapacity are refused.

ordinary_law_choices.answer: Common-tier law chooses the single numeric adulthood age and life-course programme design inside the ratified limits; neither ruling supplies the number.

protected_private_civic.answer: Identity, self-description, and intimate life-course choices are protected from prescription, outcome certification, and social scoring.

book2_operations.answer: Registration and vital-records administration, care and family proceedings, clinical and death-record operations, staffing, costs, and workflows.

external_assumptions_note.answer: Witness production, outside record arrival, and successor production are named external assumptions (FS-EXA-02, FS-EXA-03).

domains.reader_destination: Chapters on evidence, standing, and the vote; the family and life-course chapters arrive with their rule families.

domains.title: Body, health, care, family, and intimacy
domains.applicability: every person; caregivers and dependants keep separate standing
domains.status: seeded-stage-1; routing complete at domain grain
domains.severity: critical if left open — care is where private power concentrates unseen
domains.consequence: unrouted care questions default to family obligation or state absence
domains.closure_condition: contract cards complete for the family, care, reproduction, and end-of-life rule families

constitutional_invariants.answer: The health and care floor items; fiduciary, scoped, challengeable parent and caregiver powers; separation only on individualized serious-harm evidence; reproductive bodily authority throughout pregnancy; current informed treatment choice controls, including refusal of life-sustaining care; palliative care guaranteed; domestic privacy does not shelter violence or captivity.

ordinary_law_choices.answer: Medically assisted dying is democratically permissible, neither guaranteed nor prohibited; compensation regulation for gestational agreements; care-programme design above the floor.
refs: new-book-plans/book-1-family-dependency-reproduction-and-collective-plurality-decision.md::## 10. Ageing, treatment, and end of life

protected_private_civic.answer: Voluntary care, domestic production, intimacy, and family form are protected from prescription and outcome certification; marriage carries no constitutional privilege by itself; no family or household is presumed to supply the floor.

book2_operations.answer: Childcare, family proceedings, adoption, reproductive, fertility, birth, disability-support, respite, palliative, and assisted-dying service capacity, staffing, costs, and workflows.

external_assumptions_note.answer: Clinical findings, consent evidence, and death records arrive as bounded authenticated findings; their production is outside the engine (FS-EXA-03).

domains.reader_destination: The floor chapter's care and health items today; the family and care chapters arrive with their rule families.

domains.title: Learning, knowledge, media, science, religion, and culture
domains.applicability: every person; communities hold separate cultural protections
domains.status: seeded-stage-1; routing complete at domain grain
domains.severity: serious if left open — the one non-carceral delivery route lives here
domains.consequence: learning stays the only floor actuality with a non-carceral route and nothing else joins it
domains.closure_condition: contract cards complete for learning delivery, culture, and expression rule families

constitutional_invariants.answer: The learning and expression floor items; teaching plus hearing derives learning without ranking the learner; recognition for teaching is unconditional and never ranked; minority culture, language, education, and media protections; internal cultural selection bounded by universal rights.
refs: new-book-plans/book-1-family-dependency-reproduction-and-collective-plurality-decision.md::## 13. Membership, internal government, and individual rights

ordinary_law_choices.answer: Curriculum, institutions, subsidy, and cultural programme design above the floor; statutory knowledge exclusivity remains time-bounded and must yield through a compatible access route chosen by democratic law.

protected_private_civic.answer: Belief, worship, culture, expression, and inquiry are protected; no state certification of a successful intellectual or spiritual life; delivery evidence may secure conditions but may not certify learning or belief.

book2_operations.answer: Schools, libraries, media infrastructure, language services, research operations, staffing, costs, and workflows.

external_assumptions_note.answer: Two-sided arrival evidence must be written by someone; record production is external (FS-EXA-03).

domains.reader_destination: The contribution and floor chapters today; culture and knowledge chapters arrive with their rule families.

domains.title: Food, housing, land, utilities, infrastructure, and public space
domains.applicability: every person; the floor is non-contributory and unconditional
domains.status: seeded-stage-1; routing complete at domain grain
domains.severity: critical if left open — the material floor's delivery gap lives here
domains.consequence: shelter keeps deriving only through confinement and no free person's arrival is representable
domains.closure_condition: delivery and receipt rule families land for the floor items with no producing rule

constitutional_invariants.answer: The food, dwelling, and security floor items; price and ability to pay cannot gate the floor; eviction threatening the housing floor requires legality, hearing, proportionality, review, and real public continuity; genuine physical scarcity preserves each person's minimum where supply allows and records every unmet portion as failure under forbidden priority keys.

ordinary_law_choices.answer: Housing policy, land use, infrastructure investment, and utility regulation above the floor, inside the commons ceiling and portability rules.

protected_private_civic.answer: Ordinary home use, personal possessions, and plural tenure receive strong security without a right to a particular asset; domestic space is private without sheltering captivity.

book2_operations.answer: Production, inventories, facilities, procurement, meal logistics, housing stock operation, utility engineering, capacity, staffing, and costs.

external_assumptions_note.answer: Recipient-side arrival facts must be written and authenticated outside the engine (FS-EXA-03).

domains.reader_destination: The owed and placement chapters today; delivery chapters arrive with the receipt families.

domains.title: Work, property, enterprise, exchange, money, credit, debt, and public finance
domains.applicability: every person and every ownership form; no form receives priority
domains.status: seeded-stage-1; routing complete at domain grain
domains.severity: critical if left open — economic power is the main private route around the floor
domains.consequence: unrouted economic questions default to price gating the floor or scores pricing people
domains.closure_condition: contract cards complete for the economic-pluralism rule families

constitutional_invariants.answer: The floor is non-contributory and cannot be gated by price, debt, property, employment, or insurance; people may choose, refuse, leave, and change work without losing it; recognition stays binary, arity-one, non-ranked, and unread; property and inheritance are conditional liberties; collection cannot make a person floorless; enterprises receive functional capacities, never standing or a ballot.

ordinary_law_choices.answer: Rates, bases, instruments, the ownership and provider mix above the floor, above-floor wage and benefit levels, insolvency priorities, and competition thresholds — democratic law's choices inside the corridor.

protected_private_civic.answer: Voluntary gifts, pooling, mutual aid, and lawful exchange are protected from prescription and scoring; contracts stay voluntary but cannot enforce waivers of protected rights.

book2_operations.answer: Rates, budgets, models, prices, production, inventories, actuarial assumptions, monetary instruments, staffing, capacity, workflows, transition, and empirical feasibility.

external_assumptions_note.answer: Adjudicated wage or equity findings and authenticated economic projections arrive as bounded premises; the engine neither calculates nor authenticates an economy (FS-EXA-03).

domains.reader_destination: The contribution and clawback chapters today; economic chapters arrive with their rule families.

domains.title: Democracy, government, and administration
domains.applicability: every adult ordinary resident at their one political home per tier
domains.status: seeded-stage-1; routing complete at domain grain
domains.severity: critical if left open — the corridor is only as real as the institutions that hold it
domains.consequence: the ratified architecture stays prose and the legacy franchise conclusion stays the only formal democratic object
domains.closure_condition: contract cards complete for the state-form and membership rule families with retain/replace/retire cards for the legacy relations

constitutional_invariants.answer: Residence-first membership; one equal vote and candidacy at one political home; the federal three-tier structure with a justiciable subsidiarity rule; the amendment corridor; appointments anti-capture; conviction or custody alone removes neither franchise nor candidacy.

ordinary_law_choices.answer: Ordinary law, office-term numbers, seat allocations, electoral metrics, and finite fallback mechanics — delegated implementation choices inside the ratified sources, limits, defaults, and prohibitions.

protected_private_civic.answer: Political speech, association, petition, and civic organising are protected; unions and voluntary civic associations keep their own finance card requirement.

book2_operations.answer: Voter-roll and ballot administration, tallies, recounts, staffing, salaries, facilities, training, technology, clocks, and publication systems.

external_assumptions_note.answer: The external result pipeline — administration authenticates, assurance attests completeness, the result service computes, institutions execute — is outside the engine (FS-EXA-04).

domains.reader_destination: The vote and rule-change chapters today; the institutional chapters arrive with their rule families.

domains.title: Civil, criminal, and administrative justice, safety, and repair
domains.applicability: every person; the prisoner is the hardest stress test, not the default inhabitant
domains.status: seeded-stage-1; routing complete at domain grain
domains.severity: critical if left open — coercion is where the design's promises are tested
domains.consequence: the carceral machinery stays the only formalised justice and the non-carceral interface stays prose
domains.closure_condition: the non-carceral justice interface and protective-function rule families land with their finding-boundary audits

constitutional_invariants.answer: Evidence gates, conviction, placement, forgiveness, and case-bound custody authority are formal now; the ratified interface adds legality, notice, counsel, hearing, impartial review, proportionality, least-coercive response, and repair; the six protective mandates stay separated under civilian command with the categorical refusals inside the corridor.

ordinary_law_choices.answer: Ordinary criminal, civil, and administrative law content inside the corridor; narrow reviewed minimum-service rules; sentencing policy that never reads a score or earns time.

protected_private_civic.answer: Conscientious objection to a lethal or armed role is unconditional; refusal of a manifestly unlawful order is protected.
refs: new-book-plans/book-1-public-safety-defence-emergency-and-external-power-decision.md::## 10. Conscientious objection and the duty to refuse

book2_operations.answer: Capability, doctrine, training, equipment, forensics, incident command, case administration, facilities, staffing, and costs.

external_assumptions_note.answer: A later record, review, or reviewer action arriving is a named external assumption (FS-EXA-03, FS-EXA-04).

domains.reader_destination: The conviction, placement, and one-thing-taken chapters today; the protective-function chapters arrive with their rule families.

domains.title: Records, surveillance, and automated power
domains.applicability: every record that can reach standing, liberty, or the floor
domains.status: seeded-stage-1; routing complete at domain grain
domains.severity: critical if left open — the record is the design's one instrument of power
domains.consequence: an unrouted record question widens what may be written about a person
domains.closure_condition: the ratified record rule families land and the live-record boundary stays honestly stated

constitutional_invariants.answer: The record is closed by name and conclusions are derived-only; assessments, risk products, and watchlists never enter the canonical consequential person record; bulk and suspicionless collection is refused; the enforcement firewall covers enrolment; secret evidence is never sole or decisive.
refs: new-book-plans/book-1-public-safety-defence-emergency-and-external-power-decision.md::## 8. Security intelligence, surveillance, and the assessment firewall

ordinary_law_choices.answer: Retention schedules, publication formats, and diagnostic programme design inside the purpose-limitation and privacy walls.
refs: new-book-plans/book-1-substantive-equality-and-anti-subordination-decision.md::## 8. Equality diagnostics and the data wall

protected_private_civic.answer: Private records, correspondence, and self-description stay outside the consequential record; equality diagnostics are purpose-limited and privacy-preserving, never an individual conclusion.
refs: new-book-plans/book-1-substantive-equality-and-anti-subordination-decision.md::## 8. Equality diagnostics and the data wall

book2_operations.answer: Identity, storage, cryptography, replication, clocks, availability, release and toolchain integrity, and record-system operations.

external_assumptions_note.answer: Record authorship, genesis completeness, persistence, and recovery are not established by the repository; witness and record production are external (FS-EXA-03).

domains.reader_destination: The evidence and record chapters today; the surveillance and oversight chapters arrive with their rule families.

domains.title: Locality, membership, mobility, migration, and external relations
domains.applicability: everyone within jurisdiction or effective control, including newcomers
domains.status: seeded-stage-1; routing complete at domain grain
domains.severity: critical if left open — the seam where people are most easily defined out
domains.consequence: an unrouted membership question lets documentation or geography gate the floor
domains.closure_condition: federal, membership, and border rule families land with their finding-boundary audits

constitutional_invariants.answer: Three protected tiers with enumerated common powers and justiciable subsidiarity; movement as a current conclusion; jurisdiction-wide standing written as a duty; absolute non-refoulement and the collective-expulsion ban inside the corridor; no child detained for an immigration purpose; statelessness may not be created; negotiated, never unilateral, secession.
refs: new-book-plans/book-1-public-safety-defence-emergency-and-external-power-decision.md::## 12. Borders, entry, asylum, expulsion, and statelessness

ordinary_law_choices.answer: Regional and local policy inside the corridor; entry categories and external trade measures inside the ratified limits and treaties.
refs: new-book-plans/book-1-public-safety-defence-emergency-and-external-power-decision.md::## 17. Treaties, external trade, sanctions, and no evasion

protected_private_civic.answer: Choice of one political home among qualifying connections; the right to return without a diaspora ballot; local civic life protected from a lower caste of resident.

book2_operations.answer: Border and reception operations, treaty and sanctions administration, equalisation mechanics, portability plumbing, and external-relations staffing.

external_assumptions_note.answer: Other states' cooperation, recognition, readmission, and compliance are named external assumptions (FS-EXA-01).

domains.reader_destination: The movement conclusion today; locality, membership, and border chapters arrive with their rule families.

domains.title: Emergencies, security, and defence
domains.applicability: declared emergencies and protective functions; the overlay suspends nothing
domains.status: seeded-stage-1; routing complete at domain grain
domains.severity: critical if left open — emergencies are where constitutions are usually lost
domains.consequence: an unrouted emergency question invites a derogation reading the design refuses
domains.closure_condition: the emergency, defence, and intelligence rule families land after the protective-power finding-boundary audit

constitutional_invariants.answer: No derogation clause exists: a declaration confers exactly procedural acceleration, resource redirection, compensated requisition, and hazard-specific reviewable restriction; every corridor member is non-derogable; the categorical refusals on force; external-only defence mandate; each declaration and renewal needs its own source-bound temporal contract with custody-polarity authority.
refs: new-book-plans/book-1-public-safety-defence-emergency-and-external-power-decision.md::## 18. The non-derogable core and the unamendable corridor

ordinary_law_choices.answer: Hazard-specific preparedness law, the defence ceiling's level inside Assembly control, and civil-protection programme design.
refs: new-book-plans/book-1-public-safety-defence-emergency-and-external-power-decision.md::## 14. Defence: force structure and civilian command

protected_private_civic.answer: Conscientious objection stands in emergencies; no named worker may be conscripted by a minimum-service rule; ordinary life is not requisitionable into surveillance.
refs: new-book-plans/book-1-public-safety-defence-emergency-and-external-power-decision.md::## 10. Conscientious objection and the duty to refuse

book2_operations.answer: Incident command, stockpiles, restoration, readiness, doctrine, procurement, and operation under ordinary and declared shock conditions.

external_assumptions_note.answer: An emergency's outside authorisation, ratification, or end arriving in the record is external (FS-EXA-02, FS-EXA-04).

domains.reader_destination: No current chapter; the emergency and defence chapters arrive with their rule families.

domains.title: Ecology, non-human animals, commons, and future conditions
domains.applicability: every present person's environmental right; sentient animals as protected subjects; the inherited option-space
domains.status: seeded-stage-1; routing complete at domain grain
domains.severity: critical if left open — irreversible harms do not wait for formalisation
domains.consequence: ceilings, the Guardian, and animal protection stay prose while authorisations proceed
domains.closure_condition: the ecological and animal rule families land after the versioned-findings audit

constitutional_invariants.answer: An independently enforceable environmental right distinct from the floor; non-substitutable protected axes; the remedy order; the Guardian's bounded automatic pause with case-bound replay key; Class 10 protected-subject status with the severe-suffering and dispensable-killing prohibitions inside the corridor.

ordinary_law_choices.answer: Versioned ceilings and budgets enacted by democratic law inside an independently reviewed scientific envelope; detailed animal standards revisable inside the protected core.

protected_private_civic.answer: Harmless ordinary life carries no zero-risk rule; cultural, religious, and Indigenous protection creates consultation and accommodation duties without a severe-suffering exemption.

routes.title: Formal entailment (Nibli, executed by verify.sh)
routes.applicability: claims about the current source and supplied records
routes.consequence: the derivation gate is the book's spine
routes.closure_condition: stays built; its controls stay watched failing
routes.warrants: Executable engine results over the exact current source or a named bounded mutation
routes.cannot_warrant: Anything about the world: arrival, operation, feasibility, or authentication
routes.falsification_condition: A pin, counterfactual, or staged execution that must fail when its guarded property is broken
routes.negative_control: Scoped-accept controls, counterfactual fixtures, and per-generator structural mutants are watched failing on every full run

routes.title: Versioned quantitative and resource models
routes.applicability: future modelled claims bound to the envelope
routes.consequence: no modelled claim is possible today
routes.closure_condition: evidence contract, admissibility criteria, named reviewer, and in-repo gate exist
routes.warrants: Model results for their stated assumptions and envelope, once available
routes.cannot_warrant: Formal entailment, operation, or reader experience
routes.falsification_condition: not-yet-declared — a reason the route is unbuilt, not an exemption

routes.title: Dynamic simulations
routes.applicability: future simulated claims bound to the envelope
routes.consequence: no simulated claim is possible today
routes.closure_condition: evidence contract, admissibility criteria, named reviewer, and in-repo gate exist
routes.warrants: Simulation results for their stated dynamics and envelope, once available
routes.cannot_warrant: Formal entailment, operation, or reader experience
routes.falsification_condition: not-yet-declared — a reason the route is unbuilt, not an exemption

routes.title: The claim registry
routes.applicability: empirical figures about the world with provenance
routes.closure_condition: stays built; pinned-source entries stay human re-cited
routes.warrants: That a figure matches its named source at its retrieval date; staleness for script-refreshable entries
routes.cannot_warrant: Truth of the source, or anything about this design
routes.falsification_condition: A schema violation or a stale fetchable entry must fail the registry gate
routes.negative_control: The staleness gate's failure path is the route's control; the split is by name — script-refreshable entries gate on staleness, pinned-source entries are schema-checked and human re-cited

routes.title: Operational assurance
routes.applicability: future arrival, delivery, and operation claims
routes.severity: critical — the only route that can carry an arrival claim
routes.consequence: every liveness claim is Unestablished today
routes.closure_condition: evidence contract, admissibility criteria, named reviewer, and in-repo gate exist
routes.warrants: That a staffed, accountable route was exercised end to end in a named envelope, once available
routes.falsification_condition: not-yet-declared — a reason the route is unbuilt, not an exemption

routes.title: Reader and lived-experience studies
routes.applicability: comprehension, balance, and human effects for the tested audience
routes.severity: critical — Gate C's holdout condition depends on it
routes.closure_condition: the reader-evidence protocol's contract is implemented: instrument, named reviewer, in-repo gate, and the seeded control watched failing
routes.warrants: Comprehension, balance, and human effects for the tested audience within the disclosed sampling and method limits, once available
routes.cannot_warrant: Population statistics, authority over the people studied, or any legal or empirical claim
routes.falsification_condition: Declared by the reader-evidence protocol decision: the instrument must fail a seeded unbalanced or planted-misconception control, watched failing during the pilot's revise step; not yet shipped
routes.negative_control: not-yet-shipped — declared but unbuilt; the declaration does not make the route available

routes.title: Independent multidisciplinary and adversarial review
routes.applicability: scope review, red-team findings, and the Gate A warrant
routes.severity: critical — Gate A demands a warrant no other route produces
routes.consequence: independent scope review cannot yet be admitted
routes.closure_condition: evidence contract, admissibility criteria, named reviewer, and in-repo gate exist
routes.warrants: That named independent reviewers examined a named scope and their proposals received public dispositions, once available
routes.cannot_warrant: Formal entailment or the truth of any reviewed claim
routes.falsification_condition: not-yet-declared — a reason the route is unbuilt, not an exemption

external_assumptions.title: Other states cooperate and recognise
external_assumptions.consequence: readmission, recognition, and cross-border protection depend on it
external_assumptions.closure_condition: never internal — bounded per treaty and per case
external_assumptions.assumption: Other states' cooperation, recognition, readmission, and compliance are named external assumptions, not derived facts and not Book 2 deliverables.
external_assumptions.failure_consequence: The dependent duty stays owed and its restrictive conclusions withhold; nothing manufactures the outside act.

external_assumptions.title: An outside clock advances
external_assumptions.consequence: windows, renewals, and emergencies depend on supplied time evidence
external_assumptions.closure_condition: never internal — Book 2 operates clocks and time services
external_assumptions.assumption: The constitution cannot make a clock advance or prove that an outside clock advances; every temporal effect rides on supplied, witnessed time evidence.
external_assumptions.failure_consequence: Current authority fails to derive and restrictive conclusions withhold; absence never manufactures freedom or an election.

external_assumptions.title: A required record or witness arrives
external_assumptions.consequence: carries, reviews, findings, and receipts all ride on record production
external_assumptions.closure_condition: never internal — production, authentication, and persistence are outside the engine
external_assumptions.assumption: Witness production, successor records, authenticated findings, and receipt entries are produced outside the model; the repository cannot detect deletion before or inside the first attested record.
external_assumptions.failure_consequence: A person never entered is not recorded as missing; no power may treat an absent entry as a finding, and help may not be conditioned on a record entry.

external_assumptions.title: A reviewer or institution actually acts
external_assumptions.applicability: every duty, alarm, and review endpoint
external_assumptions.consequence: nothing reads obliged; the chain ends at a named duty
external_assumptions.closure_condition: never internal — operational assurance could evidence action in a named envelope
external_assumptions.assumption: That a named reader, reviewer, or institution acts on a derived duty or alarm is assumed, never derived; a duty or an alarm is not evidence that anyone acted.
external_assumptions.failure_consequence: The breach of the duty is also markable, and what runs out is not links but anybody who has to act — stated in print.
external_assumptions.source_ref: new-book-plans/book-1-public-safety-defence-emergency-and-external-power-decision.md::## 20. Oversight, review, and remedy — priced honestly

envelope.title: Reference-society envelope (stub)
envelope.severity: critical while unversioned — no functional or feasibility claim can bind
envelope.consequence: every envelope_id names this stub explicitly; nothing inherits it silently
envelope.closure_condition: the envelope item versions population, territory, resources, technology, institutions, horizon, service levels, and shock set
envelope.note: An ID placeholder only. The stub can route, never assure: no record citing it may carry an operationally-assured stage, an Evidenced liveness posture, or a remedied resolution. Its content belongs to the reference-envelope tracker item and is deliberately not seeded here.

deferred_populations.closure_condition: the roles, life-course, scale, and power-position matrix lands as records with stable FS-ROL IDs
contract cards decompose each domain's public powers into FS-POW records
the cross-domain dependency map lands as FS-DEP records classed guaranteed, democratically selected, operationally supplied, or externally assumed
the journeys, collisions, and stress cases land as FS-SCN records with stable IDs
adequacy, accessibility, continuity, resilience, and resource thresholds land as FS-THR records bound to a versioned envelope
every existing defect pin, known gap, residual, and red-team finding is backfilled as keyed FS-DFT rows before any new resolution language ships
resolution receipts exist only where a defect row's generated resolution permits one; none may precede the backfill
independent scope review runs and every proposal receives one public proposal_disposition

closure_conditions: every known material domain, role, power, dependency, scenario, and failure has an explicit disposition in the canonical source
every required projection regenerates from that source
no unresolved critical gap applicable to that gate's permitted claim remains
every non-critical residual records severity, consequence, owner, closure condition, and the resulting public-claim limitation
independent scope review leaves no proposal that has not received a public disposition
stopping_rule.materiality_test: A proposal is material when accepting it could change a declared right, liberty, power, duty, protected private boundary, cross-domain dependency, ordinary-life account, failure or recovery path, or an adequacy, accessibility, equality, continuity, resilience, sustainability, or resource criterion.
stopping_rule.boundary: Exhaustive may describe the disposition map only for the named axes above, a named source version, a named envelope, and a named review event. This is versioned exhaustiveness for those declared axes, not a timeless completeness theorem, and disclosure alone does not cure a critical gap.
stopping_rule.no_hiding_rule: No critical unresolved defect affecting a gate's permitted claim may be hidden by classification, assignment, disclosure, or a stopping-rule decision.

acceptance_gate.verdict: REVIEWED ROUTING INVENTORY; NOTHING ESTABLISHED BEYOND EACH ROW'S OWN POSTURE; GATE A NOT PASSED
acceptance_gate.rollup_rule: Any non-refused row below an established posture yields the weaker overall verdict; rows below an established posture exist, so the overall verdict is the weaker one, and it stays non-numeric by rule.
